behavioral_responses.response: During my internship at OK Zimbabwe, I contributed to ICT asset tracking and system enhancement work. I approached technical issues by gathering requirements, breaking the workflow into smaller parts, testing carefully, and documenting the solution for users.

During industrial attachment, I worked with users and ICT team members to understand support issues, communicate progress clearly, and resolve hardware, software, networking, and account-related problems.
I take initiative by identifying practical gaps and turning them into structured technical solutions, as demonstrated by my SmartShelf dissertation and ICT asset management work.
